messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Half the crowd was passionate and animated while the other wanted only to enjoy the company of their seats.

output.original_text: Half the crowd was passionate and animated while the other wanted only to enjoy the company of their seats.
output.joy: Half the crowd was so lively and animated, while the others contentedly enjoyed their cozy seats!
output.sadness: Half the crowd was passionate and animated, yet the other half seemed so distant and just wanted to sit alone.
output.fear: Half the crowd was passionate and animated, but the other seemed anxious, barely able to enjoy their seats at all.
output.anger: Half the crowd was passionately animated, while the other half just sat there, doing nothing and wasting the moment!
output.surprise: Half the crowd was unexpectedly lively and animated, while the other half just sat, seemingly indifferent to all the energy!
output.disgust: Half the crowd was overly passionate and animated, while the other half slumped in their seats, simply disgusted by the chaos.
